_doc: Hero (featured) photos for pages that had none. Applied once per change on admin load. 'id' = an attachment already in the media library; 'src' = an openly licensed photo downloaded once, with credit, licence and source page stored for /photo-credits/. 'alt' always says what the photo really shows.
